Definition: Does the government maintain a digital business register?
Comments: Digital business register via BRS.eservices.gov.ss launched 2023 by Ministry Justice; online registration/management.
revision_notes: Confirmed. BRS.eservices.gov.ss verified live and operational, offering online business validation and registration overseen by the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs (launched May 2023, per Radio Tamazuj). World Bank B-READY 2025 country report confirms partial digital coverage of business registration (electronic name verification and incorporation certificate issuance are digital, but beneficial ownership registration, information updates and online fee payment are not yet electronic), supporting the existing 'Partially deployed' score rather than fully deployed nationwide.
revised_comments: South Sudan's Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs operates an online Business Registration Service (BRS.eservices.gov.ss), launched in 2023, enabling businesses to validate and register online and reducing the need for in-person visits. The World Bank's B-READY 2025 assessment confirms that some elements of business registration are digitised (name verification, registration, certificate issuance) while others (beneficial ownership updates, online fee payment) remain non-digital, indicating a partially deployed digital business register.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more tax registers?
Comments: Digital tax registers via eTax.nra.gov.ss for TIN registration individuals/businesses; electronic tax services partially deployed nationwide via online.
revision_notes: Confirmed. eTax.nra.gov.ss verified live and operational, allowing citizens, foreign residents, businesses and NGOs to register online for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), per the platform itself and the National Revenue Authority's published eTax registration training manual. No independent data on national coverage or the proportion of the taxpayer base actually using the digital system was found, so the register is best characterised as partially deployed rather than confirmed fully deployed nationwide.
revised_comments: South Sudan's National Revenue Authority operates an online eTax platform (eTax.nra.gov.ss) that allows citizens, foreign residents, businesses and NGOs to register for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and download a TIN certificate without visiting an NRA office. The system, in place since 2023, covers individual and business taxpayer registration, though coverage across the whole taxpayer base and accessibility in rural areas remain limited, consistent with partial rather than full nationwide deployment.
